statement: Find the condition on $m$ and $c$ for the line $y=mx+c$ to be tangent to the parabola $y=x^{2}$, and give the coordinates of the point of contact in terms of $m$.
solution: At tangency, $x^{2}=mx+c$, i.e. $x^{2}-mx-c=0$, has a repeated root, so its discriminant is zero: $m^{2}+4c=0$, i.e. $c=-\\tfrac{m^{2}}{4}$. The repeated root is $x=\\tfrac{m}{2}$, giving $y=\\tfrac{m^{2}}{4}$. So the point of contact is $(\\tfrac{m}{2},\\tfrac{m^{2}}{4})$.
hints: Use the discriminant and the root formula.
